full_details: You were at the Theatre from nine. The part in your hand was headed Justice, eight speeches, the cues worn through. Nobody had the February book. Richard Cowley dried in the same place four times and apologised to Abel Garnish, then to John Heminges, then to Thomas Pope, then to you. Kemp was not come. He was at his slippers. The tireman had padded Pope to a barrel and had nothing for John Sincler that was not a rake's doublet. Pope said Sincler needs none, that Sincler is the before and he is the after. Garnish stopped prompting and read the play aloud. Heminges looked at the sun. You got all eight lines right and were thanked, not kindly. They broke at eleven no better. The Rose has Hercules again. You were home after that. The queen stayed at the hedge. You did not write a parliament. At night you noted the eight lines, and that Kemp has not been shown the book.
one_sentence: You rehearsed the old Knave until eleven, spoke eight lines right, and came home with the queen still at the hedge.
title: Rehearsed the old Knave until eleven
